definition: A Home Office approved commercial organisation that independently assesses a business idea for innovation, viability and scalability, required before a UK Innovator Founder visa application can be submitted.
longform: Endorsement is a substantive commercial assessment, not a formality alongside the visa application — an endorsing body can and does decline to endorse a weak business case. The list of approved endorsing bodies changes from time to time, so it is worth confirming an organisation is currently on the approved list before approaching it.
